tools.name: find_shops
tools.description: Find Lenius takeaway restaurants and shops in a Danish city or postal code. Optional: what the customer wants (query, e.g. "pizza"), pickup or delivery, and a date/time to check availability (returns the nearest available times).

tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: The menu of a shop from find_shops: categories and products with prices in DKK (incl. VAT) and whether they are available. A product with a unit is priced per unit (pcs, portion, pack, kg, g, l, cl, ml, m = metre). Also weight in grams, preparation time in minutes (orders for it need at least that m

tools.name: available_times
tools.description: Available pickup or delivery times for a shop on a date (default: the first date with times), the next dates with times, preparation time and upcoming closed days.

tools.name: get_shop_info
tools.description: The shop's name, company name, address, phone, e-mail, CVR (Danish company number), website, social links, logo and whether it offers pickup and delivery.

tools.name: get_opening_hours
tools.description: The shop's opening hours: the week, special days (holidays, closed days, changed hours), whether it is open now, and the times orders can be placed for per day with closed periods for orders. Use available_times for the exact times on a date.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the shop's products by name, description or category (e.g. "pizza", "vegetar", "cola"). Returns product_id, price in DKK incl. VAT, availability, image and whether the product has options.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One product: full description, price in DKK incl. VAT, all images, variants (sizes with their own price), weight, preparation time, age limit and availability.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare 2–5 specific products side by side: price (and sizes, price per kg), description, options and required choices, age limit, preparation time and availability, with a short summary (cheapest, most expensive, which have sizes or required choices). Get product_id from search_products or get_menu

tools.name: check_stock
tools.description: Whether products can be ordered now (available or sold out). Shops do not track quantities, so quantity is always null; quote_order checks again when ordering.

tools.name: get_product_options
tools.description: The options of a product: sizes, extras, ingredients to choose, free text and which are required, with option_id/choice_id and prices in the format quote_order and place_order take.

tools.name: get_shop_policies
tools.description: The shop's terms: terms of sale and its other pages (privacy, delivery, returns, complaints) with links, right of withdrawal, payment, cancellation rules, fees and minimum order, and the seller's company details.

tools.name: quote_order
tools.description: Price an order exactly like the shop checkout (lines, fees, discounts, total in DKK incl. VAT), check that the time, products, minimum order and delivery address are OK, and tell how it is paid. Nothing is saved. Shows a card with the products (with their images), fees and total so the customer can

tools.name: check_delivery
tools.description: Whether the shop delivers to an address, the delivery fee for that address (same zones and calculation as the checkout), free delivery threshold, minimum order, other fees and the next delivery time. Saves nothing.

tools.name: validate_cart
tools.description: Check a cart before quoting: every item is checked against the shop catalogue (exists, available, current price, required and valid options) and all problems are returned at once, with the price per item. With fulfillment, date and time (and address for delivery) the time, address and minimum order

tools.name: get_checkout_requirements
tools.description: What is needed before ordering at the shop: customer details (name, e-mail, phone) and their rules, address for delivery, time, accepted terms (terms_url), card payment, comment, age check for age-limited products, minimum order and fees per fulfillment, and whether the customer can log in instead o

tools.name: get_payment_link
tools.description: The link to pay an order: the shop's order page with "Betal nu" (order_url) and a QR code, while the order can still be paid. If the payment could not be created before, it is started again. For a paid, cancelled or expired order it says so instead. Never a direct link to the payment provider.

tools.name: get_payment_status
tools.description: The actual payment status of an order, looked up at the payment provider now (not only the stored status): not paid, paid (reserved), charged, released, refunded or failed, with the amount. If the customer has paid, the order is updated as on the order page.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Place the order with the shop (like the checkout). Only after the customer confirmed the quoted order and accepted the terms (terms_url). Paid by card in advance on the shop's order page: returns the order number and order_url (with "Betal nu"; the shop gets the order when paid). The customer gets a

tools.name: start_age_check
tools.description: Only when the customer orders products with an age limit from several shops: start one age check with AltID with the highest age limit across all the orders (min_age from get_menu/quote_order) and reuse the age_check_id in every place_order (valid 30 minutes after approval, at any shop). With an ord

tools.name: get_age_check
tools.description: Status of an age check: pending, approved (pass age_check_id to place_order), failed, expired or revoked. wait_seconds (max 25) waits while pending. While pending, the card shows the AltID QR code again.

tools.name: order_status
tools.description: Status of an order from place_order: awaiting_payment, awaiting_shop_approval, approved, in_kitchen, ready, out_for_delivery, completed, cancelled or rejected (and any delay).

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: An order and its current status: awaiting_payment, awaiting_shop_approval, approved, in_kitchen, ready, out_for_delivery, completed, cancelled or rejected (and any delay), items, total, order_url and the seller. Same as order_status.

tools.name: get_delivery_status
tools.description: The current status of an order as a timeline: ordered, paid, accepted, being prepared, ready / out for delivery, delivered or picked up (with times), and any delay. Status from the shop, not live courier tracking.

tools.name: get_delivery_eta
tools.description: When the order is expected ready for pickup or delivered: the chosen time plus the shop’s delay, with minutes left. An estimate from the shop’s time, not GPS.

tools.name: get_support_contact
tools.description: The right contact for a question: the shop (order, items, allergens, time, delivery, refunds, returns, complaints) with phone, e-mail and whether it is open now, or Lenius support (payment pages, login, the AI connection, technical problems, personal data).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_menu" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "The menu of a shop from find_shops: categories and products with prices in DKK (incl. VAT) and whether they are available. Optional query to only get matching products." → after: "The menu of a shop from find_shops: categories and products with prices in DKK (incl. VAT) and whether they are available. findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
